newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila rejects China claim over Scarborough Shoal.
newsitem.headline: Manila rejects China claim over Scarborough Shoal.

text.p: Philippine President Fidel Ramos on Wednesday rejected China's claim over Scarborough Shoal, a 16-km (10-mile) rock formation in the South China Sea on which Filipinos have hoisted the country's flag.
China recently protested against the flying of the Philippine flag on the disputed rock, calling the act a "serious violation" of China's sovereignty over the area.
